sapporo-to-hakodate.name: Sapporo ↔ Hakodate
sapporo-to-hakodate.approx_cost: JR limited express Hokuto, all seats reserved, about 3 h 40 min, 12 round trips a day (also stops at Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto and Onuma-Koen). Fare not confirmed: JR East's site lists ¥9,770, while JR Hokkaido's April 2026 table already gives ¥7,790 (reserved seat) for the shorter Sapporo-Oshamambe section; check JR Hokkaido before buying. Covered by the Japan Rail Pass.

tokyo-to-hakodate.name: Tokyo ↔ Hakodate
tokyo-to-hakodate.approx_cost: Hayabusa Tokyo-Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto about 4 h (reservation mandatory) + Hakodate Liner to Hakodate about 20 min; around ¥25,000 one way in total (approximate). Alternative: Haneda-Hakodate flight about 80 min, discount fares typically ¥14,000-25,000, low-cost fares from about ¥7,500.
